definitions: A specialized URL generated within the AppsFlyer platform that directs users to a specific app store or in-app content, often used for marketing campaigns.
A deep link created using AppsFlyer's OneLink technology, designed to provide a seamless user experience across different platforms and devices.
examples: The marketing team created a OneLink custom link for the new campaign.
Click on the OneLink custom link to download the app.
Each OneLink custom link tracks user acquisition data.
